name: s1ring01
note: https://www.csplib.org/Problems/prob056/data/ params-for-conjure.zip, given/s1ring01.txt (Sherali and Smith set 1, via B. M. Smith): 7 nodes, 4 rings, at most 4 nodes per ring, 8 demand arcs. Unlimited traffic capacity variant as in the reference: the file lines are origin, destination, demand (as the CSPLib mkparam.hs reads them); nodes shifted to 0-based, every arc with nonzero demand set to 1 in both directions, and the channel limit b=15 dropped. Smaller than the example (7 nodes against 10) with uniform ring capacity.
